component.name: SparkNotePad
component.summary: Lightweight Scintilla-based text and source code editor for Linux and macOS

description.p: SparkNotePad is a lightweight, high-performance native text and source code editor built with Qt 6 and powered by Scintilla and Lexilla engines.

SparkNotePad v1.3.9: Scintilla 5.6.9 & Lexilla 5.5.5 engine upgrades, Default Language setting in Preferences > Editor, Markdown front-matter syntax styling, full Qt 6.2 LTS backward compatibility, Linux ARM64 release packaging, and 14-pillar security hardening.

SparkNotePad v1.3.8: 21 built-in toolbar icon packs suite, Preferences Themes & Toolbar and Custom Toolbar Config tabs, in-tab HTML/Markdown live preview, desktop standard menu reorganization, 125 Lexilla lexers, and 100% finished bilingual localization parity (1,924 entries).
SparkNotePad v1.3.7: Command Palette Omnibar, side-by-side Myers Diff viewer, Document Statistics, plaintext docnote and changelog viewers, and security hardening.

SparkNotePad v1.3.0: Brand identity evolution to SparkNotePad, refreshed high-resolution vector and Retina iconsets, Scintilla 5.6.7 and Lexilla 5.5.4 engine optimizations, 13-pillar code quality and security hardening, and refined Indonesian localization.
